content: Sneha Roy called to check on her auto policy, which she discovered had expired on 15/08/2026. Anjali Desai from First Guard Brokers assisted her, collected the vehicle details (2019 Honda Civic, registration ABC-1234, no claims), and agreed to initiate the renewal process and send a quote by the end of the day.
